label: RL agent, training
posed_as: MDP or POMDP; the agent acts and learns in one loop

label: Chatbot, outcome reward model
posed_as: Contextual bandit: the whole reply is one action, scored by a learned reward model; KL penalty to the reference model

label: Chatbot, verifiable reward
posed_as: Contextual bandit: trace plus answer is one action, scored by a programmatic checker; reasoning steps are not scored for correctness (a format reward may apply)

label: Chatbot, process reward
posed_as: Finite-horizon deterministic tree MDP: each reasoning step is one action, scored by a process reward model

label: Tool agent, trajectory reward
posed_as: Episodic POMDP in a sandbox that is reset between episodes: tool calls are actions, reward on task success at the end

label: RL agent, deployment
posed_as: MDP or POMDP; the policy is fixed; no learning

label: Deployed chatbot
posed_as: One reply per user turn; no reward; the weights are frozen

label: Deployed tool agent, human sees each step
posed_as: Episodic POMDP with a human turn between tool calls; side effects visible before the next call

label: Deployed tool agent, autonomous
posed_as: Long-horizon POMDP; no human between calls; memory and sub-agents; no reset
